findings.problem: "The first batch of The Steep Club was made in a small amount, on purpose" functions as a soft scarcity/urgency nudge. It avoids the literally banned words (limited time, hurry, last chance) but uses the same pressure mechanism that brand/voice.md's hype/pressure ban and the campaign's own plan.md (which explicitly calls this the 'gentle urgency'/'first batch' email and warns against anything reading as fake scarcity) are meant to prevent.
findings.fix: Rewrite to state the small-batch fact neutrally without implying the reader should act before it runs out, e.g. describe it purely as a production/quality choice ('small-batch, the way we always do it') with no framing that nudges urgency.
